claim_scope: Exact Gaussian one-direction preintegration of every real affine quadratic, with a global convex-spectral dual and homogeneous indefinite closed form.
integrity: Motivating source supplies the quadratic variance-reduction criterion; this result claims only its globally exact spectral optimization and derived characterizations.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover nonlinear or non-Gaussian integrands, multi-direction integration, or convergence of QMC beyond conditional variance; not independently audited. Classical spectral dualities may offer alternate derivations.
title: Exact convex-spectral dual for optimal Gaussian preintegration of affine quadratics
